message: No detected untrusted source handling: The DVC pull (remote data fetch) has no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity check beyond a non-zero exit code check.

No detected label flipping detection: There is no validation of label values against an expected set, no distribution comparison, and no label-noise detection tool used anywhere in the data preparation pipeline.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The process_data function performs only encoding and scaling with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs on training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads the model and artifacts with joblib.load() directly from file paths without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision validation.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distributions before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation analysis, trigger detection, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard scikit-learn RandomForestClassifier without any differential privacy mechanisms such as Opacus or DP-SGD.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are imported or invoked anywhere in the codebase.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although multiple metrics (precision, recall, F1) are computed and a separate test set is used, there is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, no isolation enforcement mechanism, and no protection against metric manipulation.
No detected output bounds checks: The inference result is used directly without any NaN checks, probability bounds validation, or sanity checks on the model's output before returning it.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a tabular classification model (RandomForestClassifier), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
